spellbook.finance/limitations: This records the seller's statement of receipt. SpellBook does not verify delivery or count physical units.
The operation accepts display entries only. It does not change quantity, hold, opening plan, or marketplace listings.

description: Mark one incoming sealed display purchase entry as physically received after the seller confirms its arrival. Call spellbook_sealed_portfolio first to identify the incoming entry, then read it again to confirm owned status. This preserves its holding mark and opening plan.

entryId.description: The exact incoming display entryId from spellbook_sealed_portfolio. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the incoming entry. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_portfolio_receive
